c01-hook: OTC trading on Sui today forces a trade-off. Post on a DEX, the mempool front-runs you. Call a desk, trust them with the spread. Sealed Pair is a third option.
c02-shape: Maker encrypts terms locally and uploads ciphertext to Walrus. The blob ID is the cryptographic commitment. A sealed quote hits the public board. Taker funds escrow. Key auto-releases. Atomic transaction settles both legs.
c03-walrus: The insight: blob ID is the BLAKE2b hash of the ciphertext. Storing it on-chain turns Walrus from a CDN into a content-addressed cryptographic commitment.
c04-tatum: Fourteen distinct Sui RPC methods through the Tatum gateway. Three networks. Sixty-nine millisecond median latency. Probed live every thirty seconds.
c05-mcp: Tatum's own MCP doesn't yet ship Sui-native Blockchain Data tools. We fill that gap with four read-only Sui-native MCP tools. Compose both — AI agents get first-class Sui plus twenty-two other chains.
c06-demo-board: Live board. Twenty-five plus real on-chain orders. Polled every thirty seconds via Tatum. Pair depth aggregated from OrderPosted events.
c07-demo-vault: The Vault. Two settled trades on-chain right now. Each row has a real digest, clickable to SuiScan. Live contract introspection below proves the Move package is deployed.
c08-demo-mcp: MCP catalog. Four Sui-native tools any AI agent can call. Fills the gap Tatum's own MCP doesn't yet cover.
c09-cta: Sealed Pair. Private quotes. Public settlement. On Sui.
